title: security: rbac v2 - KMS region residency + audit enhancements
author: Jordan Kim
release_notes: Enhances RBACv2 policy evaluation paths to enforce KMS region residency and improve audit log fidelity. No customer-facing API changes. Administrators should review new policy mappings after upgrade.
description: Context: This PR addresses two related compliance gaps surfaced during the Q1 security review: (1) RBACv2 did not consistently enforce KMS region residency constraints for cross-region key references, and (2) audit logs lacked deterministic KMS key context for encrypted artifacts. Motivation: Customers operating under data residency requirements (GDPR/Schengen, APAC controls) require strong server-side enforcement and traceable audit entries tying crypto usage to region-scoped keys. What this PR does: 1) Adds a KMSRegionResidency policy evaluator module integrated into the RBACv2 evaluation chain. The evaluator short-circuits requests that reference keys outside allowed regions for the requesting org or project. 2) Extends the audit-logging pipeline to attach resolved KMS key metadata (key id, region, residency_policy_tag) to authentication-guarded audit entries while preserving PII redaction rules. 3) Introduces a configuration migration that maps existing KMS bindings to the new residency schema; migration is idempotent and only annotates bindings. 4) Adds unit and integration tests that simulate cross-region key references and assert reject/allow behavior and audit entry contents. Rollout plan: feature-gate behind "rbac_v2_kms_residency" flag; rollout to Dedicated customers in canary pool A for 48h, then expand to all Dedicated, followed by hosted API. Migration notes: On deploy the migration job runs once per control-plane shard and adds residency tags to KMS binding objects. If the migration detects ambiguous bindings it will emit a control-plane alert and write a remediation hint into the audit logs; operators can run a dry-run mode by passing MIGRATE_DRY_RUN=true. Backwards compatibility: API surface unchanged; policy semantics tightened only when the feature gate is enabled. Testing: Added 52 new unit tests and 6 end-to-end scenarios in the perf-canary harness. QA ran through the compliance checklist in Linear ENG-1987 and confirmed audit entries contain key_region and residency_policy_tag fields. Security review: Priya Shah and the security team performed a design review; crypto usage patterns were validated and we confirmed no key material is logged. Performance: Evaluation adds a sub-millisecond policy lookup for typical paths; an optional caching layer is included for hot KMS bindings to avoid control-plane throttling. Rollback: Revert the feature flag to disable enforcement while audit enhancements remain read-only. Post-merge work: update RBAC documentation and Redwood Console policy UI to surface residency constraints. Links: Linear ENG-1987, design doc https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-1987/rbac-v2-kms-region-residency, relevant runbook SUP-5012.
